{ "rules": [
    "Adjust model forecasts downward when price history shows clear downtrend to correct lag and avoid overshooting below current levels",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when price is in a consolidation range rather than trending",
    "Scale forecast deviation from model baseline by sentiment strength - stronger sentiment signals yield more divergent forecasts",
    "Apply extra downward correction to forecasts when sentiment turns negative after an extended price advance",
    "Reduce forecast confidence (increase spread between forecast and baseline) when sentiment readings are mixed or conflicting",
    "When price has been flat, sentiment-driven deviations from model forecasts should be smaller than when price is moving significantly",
    "Correct early forecast bias toward mean-reversion when historical price volatility has been unusually low"
] }
